docset:OperationalNarrative.docset:CovenantCompliance: Throughout the third quarter of 2146, the Hotei Regio facility operated in complete compliance with all covenants and technical metrics detailed in the Secured Credit Agreement (Document 8A). The cryovolcanic borehole casings maintained exceptional structural and thermal performance, posting a quarterly average Cryovolcanic Tap Stability Rating (CTSR) of 95.8%, which comfortably exceeds the 91.0% baseline standard specified in Section 4.01(1).
docset:OperationalNarrative.docset:OperationalThroughputNarrative: Deuterium oxide extraction volumes averaged 17,950 kilograms of pure heavy water per Titan sidereal day, successfully achieving the Heavy Water Yield Target of 17,500 kilograms outlined in Section 4.01(2). Consequently, the Facility Loans accrued interest at the baseline floating rate of TIDOR plus 7.75% per annum, with no triggers of the Thermal Runaway Containment Risk Premium. Additionally, our escrow balances in the Localized Seismic Escrow were fully maintained at the required SC 500,000,000 under Section 4.01(3).

docset:ValuationMemo.docset:ValuationMethodologyDescription: Valuation Methodology: The Hotei Regio Cryovolcanic facility is valued utilizing a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model reflecting specific geothermal pressure variables and localized sub-surface safety risk parameters.
